actions.condition: frightened on hit until end of scarecrow's next turn
poisoned on hit until end of merrow's next turn

implementation: Both conditions and typed timers persist on the affected combatant. The current source turn end is skipped when the hit is applied during the source's active turn; the next source-turn end expires the effect atomically.
status: XMM remains open; broad unmodeled-effect metric is 246; full monster combat automation is not certified.
